subject.title: Redesign WSL gateway setup and OpenClaw onboard UX

question: After the SSH direct-onboard blocker is fixed, should this redesigned WSL gateway setup flow and its new capability/startup defaults replace the current first-run path?
rationale: The code defect has a narrow repair path, but the PR also changes first-run product behavior and security-boundary presentation, which automation cannot accept on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Fix then accept the redesign
options.body: Require the SSH tunnel direct-onboard fix, then merge if maintainers agree with the new setup defaults and proof package.

options.title: Split behavior from polish
options.body: Land endpoint/capability persistence fixes separately from the broader UX, branding, and obsolete-tool cleanup.

options.title: Pause the replacement
options.body: Keep the replacement open without merging until maintainers are ready to choose the new first-run model.

recommendation.title: Fix then accept the redesign
recommendation.body: Require the SSH tunnel direct-onboard fix, then merge if maintainers agree with the new setup defaults and proof package.

likelyOwner.reason: shanselman is tied to the current connection/tunnel lifecycle and setup security closeout work, so they are the strongest routing candidate for the product and boundary decision.
